never_quit.description: true: Service always stay in memory running. false: Service quit when the last client disconnects.

log_level.description: Comma-separated list of logging level. 0=disabled, 7=default, 8=all, 1-6 specific levels.

netf_enabled.description: true: Enable the network filtering. false: Disable the network filtering.

netf_list.description: Comma-separated list of interface name, SSID or IP address.
